source.title: Pyretic Star — original item-side Wowhead Looter cumulative disenchanting table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated anonymous client submissions)

notes: Original live Wowhead indexed item-side Looter table reports 147 disenchant operations for Pyretic Star 219208 (one-handed mace), with four material rows reported in the source table's displayed order. This is row 1/4, with 76 source-reported positive material occurrences. The three same-name Refulgent Crystal rows represent distinct ranks, but the indexed table omits each output link/item ID: outputItemID/outputRank deliberately null, NEVER assign ranks by list order. No 0..N stack histogram or total output units exposed; do not infer 147-minus-hit 'zero-result disenchants' (only target material absent) or claim unseen stacks have size 1. Cumulative anonymous Looter data may pool time, bonus variants, skills, builds and overlapping versions; reference-only, NOT controlled/current-patch EV. One shared cohort across four rows, not 588 independent disenchants.

source.author: WoWDB item database

notes: WoWDB live item 230373 says 'Cannot be disenchanted' and 'Can be refunded', added in patch 11.2.0 build #61476, while existing Wowhead 12.1.7 PTR rank-2 Storm Dust 219947 output-side cumulative Looter table reports 5/7 occurrences for item 230373 (previously archived by worker). This is an explicit eligibility conflict requiring in-client live item-bonus/build verification; NOT proof that PTR Looter observations were valid current Retail, nor grounds to discard old source data. Block numeric EV on this item until eligibility resolved.
